messages:
Ana: heads-up — I brought up lepton-embed-v2 (quantized int6) in staging. Quick holdout run shows an odd increase in nearest-neighbor overlap between unrelated topical clusters.
Brian: can you paste the eval numbers? recall@1/5/10, MAP, and a sample failure?
Ana: recall@1: v1=0.62, v2=0.55; recall@5: v1=0.82, v2=0.79; recall@10: v1=0.89, v2=0.885. MAP dropped v1=0.71 -> v2=0.66. sample bad pair: "solar panel installation" matched to "battery storage incentives" (false neighbor).
embed-ci-bot: CI: holdout-eval job #742 finished — artifacts: https://ci/internal/lepton-v2/742 
Morgan: :eyes: Could be whitening / centering shift after the new layernorm order. Did you run per-batch mean-centering?
Ana: Not yet. I used default pipeline: tokenize -> forward -> L2 normalize.
Jess: try running eval with cosine vs dot and also disable L2 norm to see magnitude effects. Also inspect kNN params: ef_search and M. HNSW drift can cause high overlap.
Brian: also try running the same model but with int4 quant build (we had an int4 candidate earlier). If int6 quantized kernels introduced bias, that'd explain subtle rank swaps.
Ana: ok I'll run three quick probes: (1) whiten+norm, (2) cosine vs dot, (3) int4 vs int6. Will post short results. ETA ~45m.
Morgan: thx. if results look noisy we can add a small synthetic anchor test to trigger regression alerts in Optimize.
Ana: noted. thanks all, will update.
Jess: :thumbsup:
